about_the_game:
🍣 Welcome to Ugoku Sushi Bar – where conveyor belts, cozy vibes, and culinary creativity collide! 🍵

You’ve just taken over a small sushi bar tucked away in a charming Japanese neighborhood. With a humble kitchen and a head full of dreams, it’s up to you to turn your little eatery into the talk of the town.



As the conveyor belt rolls on, so does your journey. Slice, roll, and plate a growing variety of delicious Japanese dishes, serve your customers with care, and grow your reputation one satisfied guest at a time.

  • 🎏 Prepare and Plate: Craft everything from classic sushi to creative Japanese side dishes. Timing, accuracy, and presentation matter!
  • 🍥 Conveyor Belt Chaos: Fulfill orders by placing them on the belt at the right time and in the right order, or face some seriously confused customers.
  • 😺 Quirky Regulars: Meet an eclectic cast of recurring customers, each with unique tastes, stories, and personalities. Some just want sushi, others want a chat.
  • 📚 Learn & Master Recipes: Unlock new recipes as you progress, from simple nigiri to specialty rolls and surprise seasonal dishes.
  • 🛠️ Upgrade Your Kitchen: Invest in new tools, appliances, and ingredients to boost your efficiency and expand your menu.


  • 🌸 Cozy Atmosphere: A warm, relaxing art style paired with ambient sounds and music make every shift feel satisfying and peaceful.
  • 📈 Story & Progression: As your bar grows, you’ll uncover stories, unlock new décor, and even participate in local events and food festivals.
  • 🐟 Fresh Ingredients, Fresh Challenges: Seasonal fish, special requests, and daily challenges keep you on your toes while keeping things fun.


Ugoku Sushi Bar is a cozy job simulator full of flavor, charm, and heart. Whether you're a sushi enthusiast, a fan of relaxing sim games, or just love a well-told story in a small package, this game invites you to slow down, serve up joy, and savor the little victories.

Slice. Serve. Smile. Your sushi journey starts here.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 12.04, SteamOS (Proton-8 Recommended)
  • Processor: 1.7 GHz Processor
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce 8 or higher, ATI X1600 or higher, or Intel HD 3000 or higher
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: OpenAL Compatible Sound Card
  • Additional Notes: Proton-8 Recommended

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Mac OS X 10.6 or above
  • Processor: Apple Silicon M1 (M2 and M3) or Intel Core M
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 1280x720 minimum resolution, OpenGL 2.0 Support, and recommended dedicated graphics card with 128 MB of RAM
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: OpenAL Compatible Sound Card
  • Additional Notes: M1, M2, M3 Silicon Mac & ARM Supported
